verses.1:
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.2:
Give thanks to the God of gods.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.3:
Give thanks to the Lord of lords.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.4:
He alone does great wonders.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.5:
By His insight He made the heavens.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.6:
He spread out the earth upon the waters.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.7:
He made the great lights —
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.8:
the sun to rule the day,
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.9:
the moon and stars to govern the night.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.10:
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.11:
and brought Israel out from among them
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.12:
with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.13:
He divided the Red Sea + 136:13 Or the Sea of Reeds ; also in verse 15 in two
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.14:
and led Israel through the midst,
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.15:
but swept + 136:15 Hebrew shook off Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.16:
He led His people through the wilderness.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.17:
He struck down great kings
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.18:
and slaughtered mighty kings—
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.19:
Sihon king of the Amorites
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.20:
and Og king of Bashan—
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.21:
and He gave their land as an inheritance,
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.22:
a heritage to His servant Israel.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.23:
He remembered us in our low estate
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.24:
and freed us from our enemies.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.25:
He gives food to every creature.
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.26:
Give thanks to the God of heaven!
 His loving devotion endures forever.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
